context_requirements: An intact intestinal epithelium or enteric nervous system for the canonical laxative mechanism
Expression of the specific molecular target of the laxative (e.g., osmotic transporters, chloride channels, or serotonin receptors), which is not represented among the 978 landmark genes
Functional solute/water transport machinery that is not transcriptionally profiled in this assay
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of a coherent transcriptional signature (e.g., osmotic stress, ion transport, or secretory pathway genes) across multiple lines
Shared differential expression pattern among laxatives of different chemical subclasses in these cell lines
